QUOTE: Empty is also returned when `vocab_` is null, and `LlamaCppBackend::tokenize` returns empty when `tokenizer_` is unset. So "no vocab", "no tokenizer", "llama failed", and "empty input" all look the same to callers.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that a failed tokenization returns `{}` and that the backend wrapper returns empty when `tokenizer_` is unset, so the two cases are indistinguishable.
